name: CustomXMLValidationErrors
description: Represents a collection of CustomXMLValidationError objects.
example:
Dim ValErrors As CustomXMLValidationErrors
Dim ValError As CustomXMLValidationError
Dim cxp1 As CustomXMLPart
Dim intError As Integer

On Error Go To validation_error

 With ActiveDocument

    ' Add and populate a custom xml part
    set cxp1 = .CustomXMLParts.Add "<invoice>"

    ' Add a node
    cxp1.AddNode "<quantity>", "supplier", "urn:invoice:namespace"

 End With

If ValErrors.Count > 0 then
   For Each ValError In ValErrors
      DeBug.Print("Error name: " & ValError.Name & " Error description: " & ValError.Text)
   Next
End If

Exit Sub

validation_error:
   CustomXMLValidationErrors.Add(ValError.Name, ValError.Text))
Resume

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CustomXMLValidationErrors object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLValidationErrors object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CustomXMLValidationErrors object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the CustomXMLValidationErrors collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLValidationError object from the CustomXMLValidationErrors collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Node As CustomXMLNode, ErrorName As String, [ErrorText As String], [ClearedOnUpdate As Boolean])
methods.description: Adds a CustomXMLValidationError object containing an XML validation error to the CustomXMLValidationErrors collection.

parameters.name: Node
parameters.description: Represents the node where the error occurred.

parameters.name: ErrorName
parameters.description: Contains the name of the error.

parameters.name: ClearedOnUpdate
parameters.description: Specifies whether the error is to be cleared from the CustomXMLValidationErrors collection when the XML is corrected and updated.
